name: Rj Dela Cruz
tagline: I build clean, reliable software and learn something new with every project.
about: I'm an aspiring software engineer who enjoys turning problems into working software. I've been building my skills across TypeScript, React, C#, and Python, and I'm comfortable working with RESTful APIs and both SQL and MongoDB databases.

I'm especially interested in automation and data analytics: finding ways to save people time and make sense of information. Right now I'm focused on building my first real projects, starting with this site.
I'm open to entry-level roles, internships, and freelance work.
